Name: Herodias
Summary: Herodias had left Herod Philip to marry his brother Herod Antipas, a union John the Baptist denounced as unlawful. She nursed a grudge against John and used her daughter's dance to demand his head.
KeyStory: Herodias held her grudge until a birthday feast gave her the prophet's head on a charger.
LifeLesson: A grudge kept long enough finds its occasion. Herodias shows how resentment, nursed in private, kills in public.
